title: tri-ply stainless cookware
text: tri-ply stainless cookware. So far, if I could rate these 10 stars I would.  This set is amazing.  I purchased them because honestly, I am tired of buying non-stick cookware - it lasts a year or so and then I am buying another.  Off gassing/ or worse..?  Who knows.  I decided that I would give up a little ease in cleaning for a healthier, more sturdy cookware.  I am thinking this may be the last set I will ever buy.  I read up and watched a few helpful videos on what to do, how to cook with stainless, how to clean, etc.  It is a DIFFERENT way all around to use stainless.  I highly recommend that you educate yourself while you're waiting for your set to arrive.  I have not had a single thing stick to my pots/pans - but I follow the "rules" of stainless use carefully.  One of the most important things to do is to heat your stainless BEFORE adding oil.  Make certain your pan is heated to the right temp - if you spritz a few drops of water and it rolls around - you're ready.  This set is heavy, sturdy.  But not too heavy - I will note that if you're sensitive to weight - you may find this set too heavy.  I love the glass lids.  Easy to see and they go in the dishwasher easily.  I do not recommend dish washering pans - its not hard to hand clean them.  There are also tutorials on doing that too - very useful.  I couldn't be happier with my investment in buying these pans. They are wonderful to cook with - the rolled edges allowing pouring of liquids without drips - every time.  I truly can't think of a single thing that is not good about them.  I would be thrilled if this was the last set of cookware I ever had to buy.  I looked at way more expensive sets, and cheaper sets - I settled on this one for personal choice reasons - one being the glass lids.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info would be useful.

product_metadata.title: OXO Mira Tri-Ply Stainless Steel PFAS-Free Nonstick, 8" and 10" Frying Pan Skillet Set, Induction, Multi Clad, Dishwasher and Metal Utensil Safe
features: Two stainless steel layers with a heat-radiant aluminum core deliver fast and even cooking from every angle
Evershine technology helps prevent heat discoloration
Ceramic non-stick frying pans are reinforced with diamonds for outstanding non-stick performance and effortless cleanup
Free of PFAS, PFOA, lead and cadmium
Lightweight, contoured stainless steel handles keep cooking comfortable
Streamlined rivets eliminate food traps for a seamless, snag-free interior while offering a sturdy grip
The durable, all-metal construction is compatible with all stovetops
description: Mira 3-ply stainless steel collection is high-performance tri-ply built for modern kitchens. This 8” and 10" non-stick frying pan set is a must for a classic breakfast, and perfect for sautéed veggies or smaller meals. The pan is crafted with two stainless steel layers and a heat-radiant aluminum core to deliver fast and even cooking. A stain-resistant finish on the exterior prevents heat discoloration. The powerful ceramic non-stick coating is infused with diamonds to deliver remarkable non-stick ease. Plus, the ceramic non-stick coating is free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium. A lightweight, contoured stainless steel handle keeps cooking comfortable while the streamlined rivets eliminate food traps for a seamless, snag-free interior. The durable, all-metal construction is perfect for all stovetops, including induction, and can move directly from the stovetop to oven or the broiler. The tri-ply Mira collection is dishwasher safe for quick and easy cleanup. Oven safe up to 600˚F.
